document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The summoned creature appears, and then another, and then 
another. The gigantic bubble-mass horrors pour into attack from 
corridors and caverns. The battle is desperate and all seems lost, 
yet in the chaos, the Top is destroyed. Congratulations! Though 
your actions save the world, you are still doomed. The battle 
causes the cavern to collapse on top of you. In your final seconds, 
you bravely count your death as of little importance. You have 
saved the world, even though for you it is ... THE END.
(576)
